label: VERIFY_APPROVED_ABSENT
argv: ( test ! -d /proc/26799 && test ! -d /proc/27105 ); rc=$?; printf '\nRC=%s\n' "$rc"; if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then echo DONE_VERIFY_APPROVED_ABSENT; else echo FAIL_VERIFY_APPROVED_ABSENT; fi

label: PS_RECHECK
argv:
( printf 'COLLECTOR_PID=%s
' "$$"; ps -ww -eo pid,ppid,tty,lstart,etime,args ); rc=$?; printf '
RC=%s
' "$rc"; if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then echo DONE_PS_RECHECK; else echo FAIL_PS_RECHECK; fi
